title: Changing a snack list
description: You can follow replacement, addition and removal in order.

steps.description: You create three snacks and replace the element at index 1. grapes takes the place of apples.
append places cookies at the end. The list now has four elements.

steps.question: Which element becomes first after removing pretzels?
steps.answer: grapes becomes first because the remaining elements shift forward.

steps.description: You see ['grapes', 'popcorn', 'cookies'] and length 3. One append and one removal leave the original number of elements.
